video_prompt: One continuous vertical front-camera phone video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. A young man with light olive skin, jaw-length wavy dark-blond hair tucked behind his ears and light blond stubble, in a white t-shirt under an open dark denim overshirt, sits alone at a dining table in a dim kitchen at night under a warm pendant lamp, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera.
